description:
Music video for the song Gekkou, musically written by Tatsuya Kitani and Harumaki Gohan, directed by Mana Inoue and Harumaki Gohan, featuring vocals by Kagamine Rin and Hatsune Miku.

Note: There exists two versions of this song; the first being a vocaloid version featuring Kagamine Rin & Hatsune Miku uploaded on May 30, 2022 and a self-cover version by Tatsuya Kitani & Harumaki Gohan, which was uploaded on Tatsuya Kitani's YouTube channel on June 1, 2022.
